hero_kpi_rationale: Net revenue is the primary indicator of overall performance, reflecting demand for performance apparel, footwear, and accessories sold through wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels.

kpis.name: Net Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total net revenues generated from the sale of apparel, footwear, accessories and license revenues.
kpis.description: Net revenues decreased 9.4% to $5.16 billion during Fiscal 2025 from $5.70 billion in Fiscal 2024, impacted by lower demand in wholesale channel and proactive discount reduction strategies in direct-to-consumer.
kpis.signal: Declining revenues in challenging market environment.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross profit as a percentage of net revenues, representing the proportion of revenue retained after cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved 180 basis points to 47.9% in Fiscal 2025 from 46.1% in Fiscal 2024, achieved through discount reduction strategies and lower promotional activity.
kpis.signal: Improvement in profitability despite declining revenues.

kpis.name: Direct-to-Consumer Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated through owned brand and factory house stores and e-commerce websites.
kpis.description: Direct-to-consumer revenue decreased 10.5% to $2.09 billion in Fiscal 2025 from $2.34 billion in Fiscal 2024, impacted by proactive strategies to reduce discounting and promotional activity.
kpis.signal: Significant decline in DTC channel due to strategic discount reduction.

kpis.name: Wholesale Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated through sales to national, regional, independent and specialty wholesalers and distributors.
kpis.description: Wholesale revenue decreased 8.1% to $2.98 billion in Fiscal 2025 from $3.24 billion in Fiscal 2024, primarily due to lower demand.
kpis.signal: Declining wholesale revenues reflecting softer demand.

kpis.name: Apparel Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of performance apparel products across all distribution channels.
kpis.description: Apparel revenue decreased 8.9% to $3.45 billion in Fiscal 2025 from $3.79 billion in Fiscal 2024, primarily due to lower unit sales and unfavorable channel mix, partially offset by higher average selling prices.
kpis.signal: Modest decline in apparel revenue driven by lower unit sales.

kpis.name: Footwear Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of performance footwear products across all distribution channels.
kpis.description: Footwear revenue decreased 12.8% to $1.21 billion in Fiscal 2025 from $1.38 billion in Fiscal 2024, driven by lower unit sales and lower average selling prices.
kpis.signal: Significant decline in footwear revenue indicating weakness in this category.

kpis.name: Accessories Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of performance accessories across all distribution channels.
kpis.description: Accessories revenue increased 1.3% to $410.9 million in Fiscal 2025 from $405.7 million in Fiscal 2024, demonstrating relative resilience versus other product categories.
kpis.signal: Modest growth in accessories category showing relative resilience.

kpis.name: SG&A Expenses
kpis.explanation: Operating expenses related to sales, marketing, administration and general operations, excluding restructuring charges.
kpis.description: SG&A expenses increased 8.4% to $2.60 billion in Fiscal 2025 from $2.40 billion in Fiscal 2024, representing 50.4% of net revenues versus 42.1% in prior year.
kpis.signal: Increase in SG&A expenses despite lower revenues impacts profitability.

kpis.name: 2025 Restructuring Charges
kpis.explanation: Total restructuring and related charges incurred in Fiscal 2025 under the Board-approved plan to improve financial and operational efficiencies.
kpis.description: Total restructuring and related charges of $89.2 million were incurred in Fiscal 2025, comprising $57.9 million in restructuring charges and $31.2 million in SG&A transformation costs, under the 2025 restructuring plan approved to strengthen financial and operational efficiencies.
kpis.signal: Significant restructuring costs as company executes strategic efficiency plan.

kpis.name: Fiscal 2025 Net Revenues
kpis.explanation: Total net revenues generated in fiscal year 2025 across all product categories and distribution channels.
kpis.description: Net revenues decreased 9.4% to $5.16 billion in Fiscal 2025 from $5.70 billion in Fiscal 2024, impacted by lower wholesale demand and proactive discount reduction strategies.
kpis.signal: Declining revenues in challenging market environment.

kpis.name: Fiscal 2025 Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross profit margin as a percentage of net revenues for fiscal year 2025.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved 180 basis points to 47.9% in Fiscal 2025 from 46.1% in Fiscal 2024, achieved through discount and promotional activity reduction strategies.
kpis.signal: Profitability improvement despite lower revenues due to operational efficiency.

risks.title: Dependence on consumer discretionary spending
risks.score_rationale: This risk is presented first in the Economic and Industry Risks section. Strong language ('materially impact', 'negatively impacted') underscores high severity. Current macroeconomic context with inflation, recession fears and trade policy uncertainty amplifies this risk.

risks.title: Global supply chain disruptions and geopolitical events
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in Economic and Industry Risks section covering conflicts, health crises and trade policies. Language intensity ('negatively impact', 'materially harm') and global scope justify high severity rating.

risks.title: Intense competition and competitor resources
risks.score_rationale: Positioned prominently in competition section. Company faces well-resourced competitors with significant brand equity and distribution capabilities.

ai_positioning.summary: Under Armour did not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its Fiscal 2025 10-K filing.
